title: Light bulb with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='34' fill='#fff176' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='26' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.22'/>
  <!-- bulb glass body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='27' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#fffde7' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- neck of bulb -->
  <path d='M38 60 Q38 68 42 72 L58 72 Q62 68 62 60 Z' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='40' y='72' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='20' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='43' y='83' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='44' y='88' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <!-- bottom contact -->
  <path d='M46 92 Q46 96 50 96 Q54 96 54 92 Z' fill='#78909c'/>
  <!-- smiling face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffde7'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#fffde7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 43 Q50 51 58 43' fill='none' stroke='#5d4037' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.65'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#ffab91' opacity='0.65'/>
  <!-- little rays to show it's lit -->
  <g stroke='#ffd54f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'>
    <line x1='50' y1='4' x2='50' y2='11'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='13' x2='31' y2='18'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='13' x2='69' y2='18'/>
    <line x1='16' y1='36' x2='23' y2='36'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='36' x2='77' y2='36'/>
  </g>
</svg>
